questions.question: Which statement best describes serverless computing?

options.text: Applications run without any servers at all
options.why: Servers exist; the provider manages them.

options.text: You run code without managing infrastructure, and it scales automatically in response to events
options.why: Correct. This is the core of serverless.

options.text: You must reserve a fixed number of servers for one year
options.why: Reservations are a pricing model, not serverless.

options.text: Code can only run on your own on-premises servers

questions.explanation: Serverless abstracts servers away: event-driven execution, automatic scaling, no infrastructure management.

questions.scenario: You need to run a small piece of code each time a new file is uploaded to Azure Blob Storage. You do not want to manage any servers.
questions.question: Which Azure service should you use?

options.why: Correct. A blob trigger runs the function on each upload.
ExpressRoute is a private network connection.

questions.explanation: Azure Functions is Azure's event-driven serverless compute service.

questions.question: Which TWO are characteristics of serverless computing?

options.text: Billing based on execution rather than idle server time (on consumption plans)
The customer patches the operating system
options.why: The provider manages the OS in serverless.

options.text: Automatic scaling in response to demand
A fixed number of always-on servers
options.why: Serverless scales dynamically, including to zero.

questions.explanation: Serverless means consumption-based billing and automatic, event-driven scaling.

questions.question: Which Azure service lets you build automated workflows that connect apps and services using a visual designer with little or no code?

options.why: Correct. Low-code, serverless workflows with connectors.

questions.explanation: Logic Apps is a serverless workflow service with a visual designer and many connectors.
